plot_summary: John Quinn is the protagonist. On Friday, July 26, 2024 at 4:00pm, Deborah Shooter, Apricot Sweeney were involved. Deborah proposes to give John a few free tickets to a concert where she's playing  1. Deborah messages telling John about a big gig at a famous night club in San Francisco on Saturday late night. 2. John emphatically congratulates Deborah. 3. Deborah proposes that she give some of her VIP free tickets to John, and that he could bring a few friends if he wants. 4. John says he only needs one ticket to invite his girlfriend. 5. John messages Apricot asking her if she's up for going to a concert for free where his neighbor is DJing, to which she agrees. 6. John creates an event for the concert inviting Apricot. 7. John messages Deborah the next day asking about the tickets, but Deborah only replies a few days later, slightly rudely saying that she does not have any free tickets left.
